EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting ASU College of Nursing and Health Innovation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the College of Nursing and Health Innovation at Arizona State University.
Our postbaccalaureate (PBAC) Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) program allows students with a bachelor's degree in a non-nursing field from a regionally accredited institution to complete their BSN through one year of full-time study at ASU’s Downtown Phoenix campus. Graduates of the PBAC program are eligible to sit for the licensing exam to become a Registered Nurse (RN).
Students are admitted annually in the spring, and the deadline to apply each year is September 1. Placement in the program is based on clinical space availability. To learn more about this exciting option, including admission requirements and the placement process, attend a BSN Information Session either in-person or online. Once you have attended a BSN Information Session, you will be provided with instructions to apply for admission and learn about how your credits transfer to ASU.
We hope this information helps answer your questions. If you need additional assistance, please don’t hesitate to contact us.
Sincerely,
Recruitment and Admissions College of Nursing and Health Innovation Phone: 602-496-0937 Office Hours: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. conhi_undergrad@asu.edu nursingandhealth.asu.edu
